description: INSPIRE-harmonized health statistics for the Netherlands, containing doctor counts and mortality rates per 100,000 inhabitants at the NUTS2 (province) level. This is a small dataset: 12 provinces x 2 indicators = ~24 features. Geometry is MultiPolygon provincial boundaries in EPSG:3035 (ETRS89-LAEA), the European standard grid CRS. Published by CBS (Statistics Netherlands) via PDOK as part of the INSPIRE Human Health theme.

links.title: Column definitions: D2.8.III.5 INSPIRE Data Specification on Human Health and Safety – Technical Guidelines v3.0

table:columns.name: gml_id
table:columns.description: Technical XML id of the feature in the source INSPIRE GML (gml:id); unique within the delivered file, usually derived from the INSPIRE object identifier.

table:columns.name: gml_id2
table:columns.description: Technical: gml:id of the second source feature merged during flattening; a join artifact, not an INSPIRE attribute.

table:columns.name: localId
table:columns.description: Local identifier assigned by the data provider; unique within the namespace, so no other spatial object carries the same id (INSPIRE Identifier.localId, GCM).

table:columns.name: namespace
table:columns.description: Namespace uniquely identifying the data source of the spatial object; owned by the data provider (INSPIRE Identifier.namespace, GCM D2.5).

table:columns.name: versionId
table:columns.description: Identifier of this particular version of the spatial object, unique among all versions of the object; max 25 chars (INSPIRE Identifier.versionId, GCM D2.5).

table:columns.name: identifier
table:columns.description: URI/URN form of the INSPIRE external object identifier, carried as gml:identifier in the GML encoding; combines namespace and localId.

table:columns.name: identifierScheme
table:columns.description: Code space of gml:identifier, naming the scheme the identifier value belongs to (e.g. http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/ids); GML encoding, not a model attribute.

table:columns.name: language
table:columns.description: Language of the geographical name, as a three-letter code per ISO 639-3 or ISO 639-5 (GeographicalName.language, INSPIRE GN spec).

table:columns.name: nameStatus
table:columns.description: Qualitative information on the credit to give the name regarding its standardisation and/or topicality, e.g. official (GeographicalName.nameStatus, GN spec).

table:columns.name: sourceOfName
table:columns.description: Original data source from which the geographical name is taken and integrated in the data set providing it (GeographicalName.sourceOfName, GN spec).

table:columns.name: pronunciation
table:columns.description: Proper, correct or standard pronunciation of the geographical name, as IPA text and/or a sound-file link (GeographicalName.pronunciation, GN spec).

table:columns.name: text
table:columns.description: Way the name is written: the spelling text of the geographical name (SpellingOfName.text, INSPIRE GN spec).

table:columns.name: script
table:columns.description: Set of graphic symbols the name is written in, as a four-letter ISO 15924 code, e.g. Latn (SpellingOfName.script, INSPIRE GN spec).

table:columns.name: beginLifespanVersion
table:columns.description: Date and time at which this version of the spatial object was inserted or changed in the spatial data set (INSPIRE GCM lifecycle attribute, voidable).

table:columns.name: endLifespanVersion
table:columns.description: Date and time at which this version of the spatial object was superseded or retired in the spatial data set (INSPIRE GCM lifecycle attribute, voidable).

table:columns.name: timePosition
table:columns.description: Timestamp value of a flattened GML time instant (gml:timePosition), carrying the actual date/time of the feature's temporal property.

table:columns.name: validityPeriod
table:columns.description: Period when the statistical unit is supposed to be preferably used, or not (VectorStatisticalUnit.validityPeriod, INSPIRE SU spec).

table:columns.name: referencePeriod_begin
table:columns.description: Start of the period when the data are supposed to give a picture of the territorial division in statistical units (SU referencePeriod, INSPIRE SU spec).

table:columns.name: referencePeriod_end
table:columns.description: End of the period when the data are supposed to give a picture of the territorial division in statistical units (SU referencePeriod, INSPIRE SU spec).

table:columns.name: leastDetailedScale
table:columns.description: Least detailed scale the generalised geometry is suitable for, as the inverse of an indicative scale (VectorStatisticalUnitGeometry, INSPIRE SU spec).

table:columns.name: areaValue
table:columns.description: Area of the statistical unit's reference geometry (AreaStatisticalUnit.areaValue, INSPIRE SU spec).

table:columns.name: areaValue_uom
table:columns.description: Unit of measure for areaValue, from the uom attribute of the GML Area measure (e.g. m2, km2); encoding detail, not a separate model attribute.

table:columns.name: landAreaValue
table:columns.description: Area of the above-water part of the statistical unit (AreaStatisticalUnit.landAreaValue, INSPIRE SU spec).

table:columns.name: livableAreaValue
table:columns.description: Area of the livable part of the statistical unit (AreaStatisticalUnit.livableAreaValue, INSPIRE SU spec).

table:columns.name: tesselation_localId
table:columns.description: localId of the INSPIRE Identifier of the statistical tessellation this area unit composes (AreaStatisticalUnit.tessellation association, SU spec).

table:columns.name: tesselation_namespace
table:columns.description: namespace of the INSPIRE Identifier of the statistical tessellation this area unit composes (AreaStatisticalUnit.tessellation association, SU spec).

table:columns.name: HH_NL_NUTS2_doctors_STATCODE
table:columns.description: Code of the NUTS 2 statistical unit the doctors statistic refers to; HH statistical data are attached to Statistical Units (INSPIRE HH spec).

table:columns.name: HH_NL_NUTS2_doctors_YEAR
table:columns.description: Reference year of the doctors statistic: the time period the statistical data cover (HH referencePeriod, INSPIRE HH spec).

table:columns.name: HH_NL_NUTS2_doctors_OBS_VALUE
table:columns.description: Value of the health services statistic: doctors per 100 000 inhabitants in the NUTS 2 region (HealthServicesStatistic value, INSPIRE HH spec).

table:columns.name: fuuid
table:columns.description: Not defined in any INSPIRE specification; a per-feature UUID added by the ETL/flattening tooling.

table:columns.name: geom
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, WKB encoded; see proj:epsg for the CRS.

table:columns.name: geom_bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: float, ymin: float, xmax: float, ymax: float>
table:columns.description: Technical: per-feature bounding box struct added for spatial filtering (GeoParquet covering).

table:columns.name: HH_NL_NUTS2_nrdeath_STATCODE
table:columns.description: Code of the NUTS 2 statistical unit the deaths statistic refers to; HH statistical data are attached to Statistical Units (INSPIRE HH spec).

table:columns.name: HH_NL_NUTS2_nrdeath_JAAR
table:columns.description: Reference year (Dutch: jaar) of the deaths statistic: the time period the statistical data cover (HH referencePeriod, INSPIRE HH spec).

table:columns.name: HH_NL_NUTS2_nrdeath_OBS_VALUE
table:columns.description: Value of the mortality statistic: deaths per 100 000 inhabitants in the NUTS 2 region (HH health statistical data value, INSPIRE HH spec).
